EPFO Approves Pension Orders, Updates on Higher Pension Applications

The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has approved 1.49 lakh pension payment orders. Updates are available for those who applied for higher pensions, with information regarding the deadline and government statements on the matter. Pensioners can check their status via the UMANG app.
